$comment: Values observed in the source collection, not invented. tokens.css is generated from this file by scripts/build-registry.mjs.

ramp.$comment: The warm-grey ladder chart marks actually draw with, ordered light to dark. Marks are set imperatively in JS with literal hex, so there is no var() to check; the conformance lint enforces MEMBERSHIP of this list instead. That freezes today's palette and fails any new colour, which is the point. These 37 steps are recorded reality, not a designed scale — several pairs are within one or two values of each other (#D8D7D1 / #D8D6CE, #55554F / #55544E / #55534B) and consolidating them is open technical debt.

stroke.$comment: Sub-pixel hairlines are the single strongest signature of this language. lineMax applies to anything that reads as a line; ribbon and band charts, where the stroke IS the area and its width encodes magnitude, are exempt.

font.$comment: Monospace was in use before it was a token: the gallery hand-styled inline code and the nodex add command row. Naming it here makes the code and prose primitives themeable rather than hardcoding a stack.
font.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
